dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: ...Ignorance might be a blessing, and knowledge might bring forth calamity...

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: ...Only that which graced with the ambrosia of knowledge can flourish into the strong...

dialogues.speaker: Xamaran
dialogues.text: ...Only that which has been tested with the desolation of wandering can brave the wilderness...
